svg.aria-label: 目标联系，不表示充分精化
svg.text: 独立于成立精化；箭头按联系类型解释，状态逐项标明。

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
Be entertained while exercising (running or on the exercise bike), which can be monotonous
. → Fill the time I spend biking, driving, cooking and doing other activities with video o
r music so that I am entertained.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
Watch a video at home while doing other things such as cooking. → Fill the time I spend bi
king, driving, cooking and doing other activities with video or music so that I am enterta
ined.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Choose a video whose length fills the time I have available (exactly the remaining bike ti
me, otherwise a 10 to 30 minute video as a safe bet). → Fill the time I spend biking, driv
ing, cooking and doing other activities with video or music so that I am entertained.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Browse the YouTube recommendations screen to find a video that appeals to me. → Find a new
thing to watch easily.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Keep videos saved in a Watch later list for later viewing. → Find something to watch when
the recommendations do not surface anything I want, by going to Watch later or searching f
or something I am interested in.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Download videos in advance when I have good Wi-Fi beforehand, so I have them for a long tr
ip / driving. → Fill the time I spend biking, driving, cooking and doing other activities
with video or music so that I am entertained.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 实现方式
Maybe require some sort of basic test (an IQ-style test or even just any basic test) befor
e people are allowed to comment. → Have smarter users in YouTube comments (my biggest wish
for YouTube), because commenters are often pretty dumb.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Have recommendations that reflect my long-standing preferences and watch history. → Stay o
n YouTube instead of switching to another streaming platform.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
Before submitting an assignment, open its description and fetch the information needed to
do the assignment. → Submit a PDF report by uploading the file with the file uploader in C
anvas.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
Submit a code repository by using Gradescope's feature to fetch my latest commit from GitH
ub and submit my codebase. → Know my grade immediately after submitting a code assignment,
while taking it as not the final grade.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Have coding projects auto-graded by the app, because that is very convenient for coding pr
ojects. → Know my grade immediately after submitting a code assignment, while taking it as
not the final grade.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
Submit a PDF report by uploading the file with the file uploader in Canvas. → Submit the a
ssignments I have to do for my course through the course's web app (Canvas or Gradescope).

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 范围具体化
Submit a code repository by using Gradescope's feature to fetch my latest commit from GitH
ub and submit my codebase. → Submit the assignments I have to do for my course through the
course's web app (Canvas or Gradescope).

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 过程先后
Reach the assignment page or grading page by going through the app homepage/dashboard and
selecting the course. → See the list of assignments I have previously submitted and have n
ot yet submitted, and choose one to look inside.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
See a real-time estimated grade for my previously submitted and graded assignments in Canv
as. → Decide how much time to spend on a course using the estimated-grade / indirect feedb
ack information.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
See a real-time estimated grade for my previously submitted and graded assignments in Canv
as. → Decide whether to try extra credit to boost my grade using the estimated-grade / ind
irect feedback information.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
See a detailed per-part grading breakdown (subgrades) through the rubric feature in Canvas
. → Get feedback in the form of a document with comments after the assignment is graded, s
o I can see in detail where I can improve.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
See the feedback comments while viewing my submitted assignment in the document viewer. →
Get feedback in the form of a document with comments after the assignment is graded, so I
can see in detail where I can improve.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Use another app when one app does not have enough features, so the needed feature is suppo
rted. → Submit the assignments I have to do for my course through the course's web app (Ca
nvas or Gradescope).

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
Have feedback comments attached to the specific place in the assignment they refer to, ins
tead of being inserted only in a global part. → Get feedback in the form of a document wit
h comments after the assignment is graded, so I can see in detail where I can improve.

g.aria-label: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
g.text: 有依据的联系 · 有助于
When a professor publishes the assignment on a website, get all the details from that webs
ite and then submit through the linked app such as Gradescope. → Submit the assignments I
have to do for my course through the course's web app (Canvas or Gradescope).
